verdict: Cost per lead improved sharply, but 7 leads in 28 days is too thin.
narrative: Your cost per lead dropped 50% week-over-week to roughly $125, which is a real efficiency gain — but with only 7 tracked leads over the full 28-day window, the volume is too low to treat that improvement as a trend. Meta is carrying all tracked lead volume right now while Google Ads spend was pulled back and concentrated into the Local Services campaign, where buyer intent is highest. At the same time, Google Business Profile activity fell sharply this past week, which means the organic floor needs attention alongside paid. Confirming an intake owner and clearing several overdue pipeline items are the immediate priorities to unblock scale-up before heating season campaigns go live October 1.
